author: UmbreonMessiah
body: When I'm going to join a server, I often don't look at the game being played at that moment, I look at the rotation. But sometimes, it does get a bit tedious looking through all the servers and doing /rot, as it takes quite a while due to lag. I think it would be much nicer if maybe you guys could find a way to show the rots in the server connection screen menu thing. (When you click the compass, not the signs.) It isn't much, but I think it'd make the server a just that little extra bit better.
